status: PREREGISTERED - written and saved before any simulation code was written or run
subject: Independent re-implementation of the forward-merger point-vortex gas (ADG integrator) behind Pillar IV of the fluid-dynamics volume; manuscript 'Vortex-Merger Thermodynamics in 2D Turbulence: A Metriplectic Scenario for the Onsager Anomaly', SM S1, S3, S5

claim_under_test.text: As r_c decreases 0.010 -> 0.005 -> 0.002 (Re_eff up), the time-averaged event dissipation eps_bind and total dissipation eps_tot, in units E0/T0, saturate to an O(1) plateau eps_sat ~= 0.2 with only a few-percent spread across N, r_c and seeds.

model_as_specified_in_SM.vortices: N identical like-signed point vortices, Gamma_i = 1 initially (units cancel in eps normalised by E0/T0)
model_as_specified_in_SM.H_flow: (1/2) sum_{i!=j} Gamma_i Gamma_j G(x_i - x_j), G = zero-mean doubly periodic Green's function of -Laplacian (neutralising background, needed because net circulation is non-zero); G ~ -(1/2pi) ln r at short range, i.e. the SM Kirchhoff form Eq.(4) with the periodic image sum instead of bare minimum-image log
model_as_specified_in_SM.merger: whenever |x_i - x_j|_P < r_c: replace by one vortex of circulation Gamma_i+Gamma_j at the circulation-weighted centre (periodic-aware); Delta H_int = -Delta H_flow (SM Eq. 5/22)
model_as_specified_in_SM.integrator: Average (mean-value) Discrete Gradient step z* - z_n = dt J grad_bar H(z_n, z*), grad_bar H evaluated by Gauss-Legendre quadrature of Eq.(18), solved by fixed-point iteration; adaptive dt limited by the closest pair; merger check after every step. Energy drift of the conservative step is recorded.
model_as_specified_in_SM.IC: K = 5 Gaussian clumps (centres uniform on the torus, std sigma = 0.3), N/K vortices each; purely Hamiltonian pre-run of 0.05 T0 with mergers off; then mergers on.
model_as_specified_in_SM.units: E0 = H_flow at switch-on (t=0); U0 = sqrt(2 E0 / L^2) (rms velocity of a flow with energy E0 in area L^2); T0 = L / U0. eps in units E0/T0.
model_as_specified_in_SM.eps_tot: -[H_flow(t_max) - H_flow(t_trans)] / (t_max - t_trans), in E0/T0 (equals eps_bind up to integrator drift; the SM gives no other definition)
model_as_specified_in_SM.Re_eff: the SM gives no formula for nu_eff(r_c); we report Re_eff = L / r_c (i.e. nu_eff = U0 r_c) and note the CSV uses ~10/r_c

compute_reduction_declared_in_advance: O(N^2) numpy cost with ~10 min total budget: primary ensemble N = 200 (not 500/1000/2000), secondary N = 100; 5 seeds each. If wall-time forces a shorter t_max, the reduction is decided from wall-clock timing only (no eps values inspected) and is reported.
no_tuning: No parameter above is changed after results are seen. Nothing is tuned toward 0.2.

pass_criteria_for_paper_claim.P1_plateau: ensemble-mean eps_bind at r_c=0.002 divided by that at r_c=0.010 lies in [0.90, 1.10] (CSV: 1.057) for the primary N
pass_criteria_for_paper_claim.P2_level: every (N, r_c) ensemble-mean eps_bind and eps_tot lies in [0.15, 0.25] (0.2 +/- 25%)
pass_criteria_for_paper_claim.P3_spread: seed-to-seed coefficient of variation of eps_bind <= 5% at each (N, r_c) (CSV: ~2%)
pass_criteria_for_paper_claim.verdict_rule: claim REPRODUCED only if P1, P2 and P3 all pass; otherwise NOT REPRODUCED, recorded as such

internal_consistency_checks_on_shipped_C: C1: each merger removes exactly one vortex, so n_mergers + N_final must equal N in every row
C2: direction of n_mergers vs r_c (a smaller merger cross-section should not produce more mergers in the same time window unless the window is rescaled)
C3: whether seed-to-seed deviations and eps_tot - eps_bind are identical across r_c (would indicate a generated rather than simulated table)

by_construction_tests.T1_rc_dependence: fit eps_bind ~ r_c^alpha across the three r_c; a plateau means alpha ~ 0
by_construction_tests.T2_binding_fraction: per-merger released energy compared with the analytic pair self-term Gamma_i Gamma_j G(r_ij at merger); report the fraction of Delta H_flow carried by that term (expected ~1, i.e. release ~ (Gamma_i Gamma_j / 2pi) ln(1/r_c): the 'binding energy' is the r_c-regularised self-energy)
T3_neutral_accounting: A: shift the additive constant of G (gauge; leaves the dynamics identical) from zero-mean to G = -(1/2pi) ln(r/L)-normalised form: recompute eps_bind from the same trajectories

B: finite-core accounting: give each vortex a core radius a = r_c/2 with area-conserving merger (a' = sqrt(a1^2 + a2^2)) and include Rankine self-energies (Gamma^2/4pi)(ln(1/a) + 1/4) in H_flow: recompute released energy from the same trajectories
C: merger triggered at r_c but energy release evaluated with the pair term only (no periodic images) vs full periodic G
by_construction_tests.interpretation_rule: if the plateau (P1) holds only under the SM accounting and moves or changes sign under A/B, the saturation is an accounting artefact rather than a dynamical result
